name: Holbrook
description: Ten separate rounds of 5 thrusters, 10 pull-ups and a 100 m sprint, each timed on its own with a minute of rest between them.
source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/holbrook (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-10-16; each round is timed on its own, 1 minute of rest between rounds
